steps.title: Measure and Improve

title: Ship Software with Supervised Vibecoding
description: Workflow end-to-end AI-heavy dengan human gates untuk requirements, architecture, implementation, QA, security, release, operations, dan task-to-skill.

steps.title: DEV-01 Requirements / xRD
steps.description: 90% vibecoding, 10% semi-manual. AI menyusun requirements/xRD minimum yang implementation-ready; manusia meng-approve scope dan ambiguity material.

steps.title: DEV-02 Architecture
steps.description: 80% vibecoding, 20% semi-manual. AI merancang boundaries, stack, API, data, auth, failure handling, dan deployment; keputusan arsitektur material menunggu approval.

steps.title: UI/UX Design Gate
steps.description: 90% vibecoding, 10% semi-manual. Route kebutuhan interface ke Universal Design Production dan specialist anti-slop; hasilnya menjadi UI specification untuk implementasi.

steps.title: DEV-03 Implementation
steps.description: 90–95% vibecoding, 5–10% semi-manual. Coding agent menginspeksi repo dan mengimplementasikan scope terkecil yang disetujui tanpa unrelated refactor atau speculative feature.

steps.title: DEV-04 Diagnostic Debug
steps.description: 90% vibecoding, 10% semi-manual. Bila ada error, diagnosis evidence-first dilakukan sebelum minimal fix; manusia membantu hanya saat evidence/akses diperlukan.
steps.output: Confirmed root cause, minimal fix, verification evidence

steps.title: DEV-05 Verification & QA
steps.description: 90% vibecoding, 10% semi-manual. AI memetakan acceptance criteria ke lint/typecheck/unit/integration/E2E/accessibility/regression sesuai risiko dan melaporkan hasil aktual.
steps.output: QA coverage matrix and test evidence

steps.title: DEV-06 Refactor Gate
steps.description: 80% vibecoding, 20% semi-manual. Audit dead code/duplication/quality lebih dulu; destructive atau broad refactor menunggu approval dan confidence di bawah 90% tetap HOLD.

steps.title: EXT-SEC01 Security Gate
steps.description: 70% vibecoding, 30% semi-manual. AI melakukan application-security review P0–P3; P0/P1 memblokir release dan perubahan security-critical yang material membutuhkan approval.

steps.title: DEV-07 Git / Release
steps.description: 80% vibecoding, 20% semi-manual. AI menyiapkan atomic commits, PR, CI evidence, preview/staging, changelog, dan release candidate. Merge/main dan production deploy tetap human gate.

steps.title: DEV-08 Operations
steps.description: 60–75% vibecoding, 25–40% semi-manual. AI menyiapkan health checks, observability, backup/restore, rollback, incident triage, dan post-release verification; risky production remediation tetap supervised.

steps.title: META-SKILL01 Task → Skill
steps.description: 90% vibecoding, 10% semi-manual. Hanya task reusable, repeatable, domain-independent, clear, testable, dan terbukti yang diekstrak menjadi DRAFT Skill; activation membutuhkan regression PASS dan human approval.
steps.output: Draft reusable skill or explicit no-graduate decision
